convert.text: Converting from WSL{{from}} to WSL{{to}}. This can take several minutes, and the distribution must be stopped. Export it first if it matters.

sparse.text: Sparse mode lets WSL give freed space back to the Windows disk. The distribution must be stopped.

update.warning: Updating stops all distributions and open terminals. Windows may ask for permission.

form.exportHint: An existing file is never overwritten. Exporting can take several minutes.

delete.text: This cannot be undone: the distribution, all its files and its virtual disk will be erased. Consider exporting it first.
